title: Chronic progressive demyelination induces a microglial state with lysosomal dysfunction
title_zh: 慢性进行性脱髓鞘诱导具有溶酶体功能障碍的微胶质细胞状态
abstract: Abstract Dysfunctional immune responses impair remyelination and contribute to neurodegeneration. While immune and metabolic responses to acute myelin injury are well characterized, myeloid cell adaptations to chronic myelin damage remain poorly understood. Here we performed a comparative analysis of genetic and toxic mouse models of acute and chronic demyelination, which identified a distinct microglial state associated with chronic demyelination, characterized by sustained pro-inflammatory activation, lysosomal lipid sequestration and reduced lipid droplet formation. Transcriptomics profiling further revealed a metabolic program marked by upregulated cholesterol synthesis and diminished sterol efflux. Treatment with a desmosterol mimetic possessing 24-dehydrocholesterol reductase inhibitor activity reversed this microglial state, attenuated pro-inflammatory signaling (including C-C Motif Chemokine Ligand 4 expression), reduced myelin damage and improved motor performance in a mouse model of leukodystrophy. Our findings uncover a pro-inflammatory microglial state characterized by lysosomal dysfunction and increased myelin reactivity, highlighting a novel therapeutic target for chronic demyelinating disorders.
abstract_zh: 摘要：功能失调的免疫反应会削弱再髓鞘化并促成神经退行性变。虽然急性髓鞘损伤的免疫与代谢反应已被充分阐明，但慢性髓鞘损伤中髓系细胞的适应机制仍不清楚。我们对急性与慢性脱髓鞘的遗传与毒性小鼠模型进行了比较分析，发现了一种与慢性脱髓鞘相关的独特微胶质细胞状态，该状态表现为持续的促炎激活、溶酶体脂质滞留以及脂滴形成减少。转录组学分析进一步揭示了一个代谢程序，标志为胆固醇合成上调和甾醇外排下降。使用具有24-脱氢胆固醇还原酶抑制活性的去甲胆固醇模拟物治疗可逆转该微胶质细胞状态，抑制促炎信号（包括C-C基序趋化因子配体4表达），减少髓鞘损伤并改善白质变性小鼠模型的运动表现。我们的研究揭示了一种以溶酶体功能障碍和髓鞘反应性增强为特征的促炎微胶质细胞状态，突显了慢性脱髓鞘疾病的一个新治疗靶点。
